english_text: It is important to understand your medical condition.
sesotho_text: Ho bohlokoa ho utloisisa boemo ba hao ba bongaka.

english_text: Knowing about your illness helps you manage it better.
sesotho_text: Ho tseba ka bolwetse ba hao bo a thusa ho bo laola hantle.

english_text: You have the right to ask your doctor questions about your health.
sesotho_text: O na le tokelo ea ho botsa ngaka ea hao lipotso ka bophelo ba hao.

english_text: You have the right to receive clear information about your diagnosis.
sesotho_text: O na le tokelo ea ho amohela tlhahisoleseling e hlakisitsoeng ka tlhahlobo ea hao.

english_text: You have the right to be involved in decisions about your treatment.
sesotho_text: O na le tokelo ea ho kenyeletsoa liqetong ka phekolo ea hao.

english_text: You have the right to refuse treatment after being fully informed.
sesotho_text: O na le tokelo ea ho hana phekolo ka mor'a ho tsebisoa ka botlalo.

english_text: You have the right to confidentiality about your health information.
sesotho_text: O na le tokelo ea sephiri ka tlhahisoleseling ea bophelo ba hao.

english_text: Your medical information cannot be shared without your consent.
sesotho_text: Tlhahisoleseling ea hao ea bongaka ha e khone ho aroleloa ntle le tumelo ea hao.

english_text: You have the right to access your own medical records.
sesotho_text: O na le tokelo ea ho fihlela lirekoto tsa hao tsa bongaka.

english_text: You have the right to a second opinion from another doctor.
sesotho_text: O na le tokelo ea ho fumana maikutlo a bobeli ho tsoa ngakeng e nngwe.

english_text: It is important to tell your doctor about all your symptoms.
sesotho_text: Ho bohlokoa ho bolella ngaka ea hao matšoao a hao ohle.

english_text: Always tell your doctor about all the medications you are taking.
sesotho_text: Bolella ngaka ea hao kamehla ka meriana yohle eo o e nkang.

english_text: Tell your doctor about any traditional or herbal medicines you use.
sesotho_text: Bolella ngaka ea hao ka meriana efe kafe ea setso kapa ea limela eo o e sebelisang.

english_text: Tell your doctor if you are allergic to any medication.
sesotho_text: Bolella ngaka ea hao haeba o na le allergy ho moriana ofe kafe.

english_text: Always inform the nurse if your condition changes between visits.
sesotho_text: Tsebisa mooki kamehla haeba boemo ba hao bo fetohile lipakeng tsa litsebeliso.

english_text: It is important to attend all your scheduled medical appointments.
sesotho_text: Ho bohlokoa ho tla li-appointment tsohle tsa hao tsa bongaka tse reretseng.

english_text: Missing appointments can delay your treatment and recovery.
sesotho_text: Ho lahlehela li-appointment ho ka lieha phekolo ea hao le ho fola.

english_text: Regular check-ups help detect health problems early.
sesotho_text: Litlhahlobo tsa kamehla li thusa ho fumana mathata a bophelo kapele.

english_text: Early detection of illness leads to better treatment outcomes.
sesotho_text: Ho fumana bolwetse kapele ho lebisa liphetho tse ntle tsa phekolo.

english_text: Prevention is better than cure.
sesotho_text: Ho thibela ho feta ho alafa.

english_text: A healthy lifestyle reduces the risk of many diseases.
sesotho_text: Mokhoa oa bophelo o motle o fokotsa kotsi ea mahlwetse a mangata.

english_text: Regular physical activity improves your overall health.
sesotho_text: Mesebetsi ea 'mele ea kamehla e ntlafatsa bophelo ba hao ka bophara.

english_text: A balanced diet supports your immune system and recovery.
sesotho_text: Phepo e lekaneng e tshehetsa tšireletso ea 'mele oa hao le ho fola.

english_text: Drinking enough water every day is important for your health.
sesotho_text: Ho noa metsi a lekaneng letsatsi le leng le le leng ho bohlokoa bakeng sa bophelo ba hao.

english_text: Getting enough sleep helps your body heal and stay healthy.
sesotho_text: Ho robala ka lekaneng ho thusa 'mele oa hao ho fola le ho lula o phela hantle.

english_text: Reducing stress improves your mental and physical health.
sesotho_text: Ho fokotsa khatello ea maikutlo ho ntlafatsa bophelo ba hao ba kelello le ba 'mele.

english_text: Avoiding alcohol reduces the risk of liver disease and other conditions.
sesotho_text: Ho hana joala ho fokotsa kotsi ea bolwetse ba sebete le maemo a mang.

english_text: Stopping smoking improves your lung health and overall wellbeing.
sesotho_text: Ho emisa ho tsuba ho ntlafatsa bophelo ba matšoafo a hao le boiketlo ba hao ka bophara.

english_text: Maintaining a healthy weight reduces the risk of chronic diseases.
sesotho_text: Ho boloka boima bo botle bo fokotsa kotsi ea mahlwetse a tsoelang pele.

english_text: Regular hand washing prevents the spread of infections.
sesotho_text: Ho hlatsoa matsoho ka mehla ho thibela ho atatela ha tšoaetso.

english_text: Good hygiene protects you and your family from illness.
sesotho_text: Bohloekileng bo botle bo sireletsa uena le lelapa la hao ho bolwetse.

english_text: Vaccinations protect you from serious and preventable diseases.
sesotho_text: Liente li a sireletsa ho mahlwetse a matla le a thibelehang.

english_text: It is important to keep your vaccinations up to date.
sesotho_text: Ho bohlokoa ho boloka liente tsa hao li ntlafetse.

english_text: Screening tests help detect diseases before symptoms appear.
sesotho_text: Litlhahlobo tsa ho hlahloba li thusa ho fumana mahlwetse pele matšoao a hlaha.

english_text: Regular blood pressure checks can prevent heart disease and stroke.
sesotho_text: Ho lekola khatello ea mali ka mehla ho ka thibela bolwetse ba pelo le stroke.

english_text: Regular blood sugar checks help manage and prevent diabetes.
sesotho_text: Ho lekola tsoekere ea mali ka mehla ho thusa ho laola le ho thibela tsoekere.

english_text: Regular cholesterol checks reduce the risk of heart disease.
sesotho_text: Ho lekola cholesterol ka mehla ho fokotsa kotsi ea bolwetse ba pelo.

english_text: Cancer screening saves lives through early detection.
sesotho_text: Ho hlahloba kankere ho boloka bophelo ka ho fumana kapele.

english_text: Eye examinations help detect vision problems and other conditions.
sesotho_text: Litlhahlobo tsa mahlo li thusa ho fumana mathata a pono le maemo a mang.

english_text: Dental check-ups prevent tooth decay and gum disease.
sesotho_text: Litlhahlobo tsa meno li thibela ho bola ha meno le bolwetse ba meno.

english_text: Mental health is as important as physical health.
sesotho_text: Bophelo ba kelello bo bohlokoa joalo ka bophelo ba 'mele.

english_text: It is important to seek help if you are feeling depressed or anxious.
sesotho_text: Ho bohlokoa ho batla thuso haeba o ikutloa o khutsanyehile kapa o tšohile.

english_text: Talking about your feelings can improve your mental health.
sesotho_text: Ho bua ka maikutlo a hao ho ka ntlafatsa bophelo ba hao ba kelello.

english_text: Support from family and friends is important for recovery.
sesotho_text: Tshehetso ho tsoa lelapeng le baratwi bo bohlokoa bakeng sa ho fola.

english_text: Community support groups can help you manage your condition.
sesotho_text: Lisehlopha tsa tshehetso ea sechaba li ka thusa ho laola boemo ba hao.

english_text: Health education helps you make informed decisions about your health.
sesotho_text: Thuto ea bophelo bo botle e thusa ho etsa liqeto tse tsebisitsoeng ka bophelo ba hao.

english_text: Understanding your medication helps you take it correctly.
sesotho_text: Ho utloisisa moriana oa hao ho thusa ho o nka ka nepo.

english_text: Following your treatment plan improves your health outcomes.
sesotho_text: Ho latela leano la phekolo ea hao ho ntlafatsa liphetho tsa bophelo ba hao.

english_text: Completing your full course of treatment prevents drug resistance.
sesotho_text: Ho phetela khoroso yohle ea phekolo ho thibela ho hana ha moriana.

english_text: Never share your medication with other people.
sesotho_text: O se ke oa arolelana moriana oa hao le batho ba bang.

english_text: Never stop your medication without consulting your doctor.
sesotho_text: O se ke oa emisa moriana oa hao ntle le ho buisana le ngaka ea hao.

english_text: Always take your medication at the same time every day.
sesotho_text: Nka moriana oa hao ka nako e tšoanang letsatsi le leng le le leng kamehla.

english_text: Store your medication in a cool dry place away from sunlight.
sesotho_text: Boloka moriana oa hao sebakeng se batang se omileng hole le leseli la letsatsi.

english_text: Keep all medications out of reach of children.
sesotho_text: Boloka meriana yohle hole le bana.

english_text: Check the expiry date of your medication before taking it.
sesotho_text: Hlahloba letsatsi la ho fela ha moriana oa hao pele ho o nka.

english_text: Dispose of expired medication safely and responsibly.
sesotho_text: Lahla moriana o felileng ka polokeho le boikarabello.

english_text: Report any side effects of your medication to the clinic.
sesotho_text: Bua ka litlamorao tse ling tsohle tsa moriana oa hao klinikeng.

english_text: Ask the pharmacist if you are unsure how to take your medication.
sesotho_text: Botsa pharmacist haeba ha o tsebe ho nka moriana oa hao.

english_text: Read the information leaflet that comes with your medication.
sesotho_text: Bala pampiri ea tlhahisoleseling e tlang le moriana oa hao.

english_text: Understanding your treatment empowers you to take control of your health.
sesotho_text: Ho utloisisa phekolo ea hao ho o mpha matla a ho laola bophelo ba hao.

english_text: Wash your hands with soap and water for at least twenty seconds.
sesotho_text: Hlatsoa matsoho a hao ka sesepa le metsi bonyane metsotso e mashome a mabeli.

english_text: Wash your hands before eating and after using the toilet.
sesotho_text: Hlatsoa matsoho a hao pele ho ja le ka mor'a ho sebelisa ntlo ea thokomelo.

english_text: Wash your hands after coughing or sneezing.
sesotho_text: Hlatsoa matsoho a hao ka mor'a ho kohoa kapa ho thiimela.

english_text: Wash your hands after touching animals or animal waste.
sesotho_text: Hlatsoa matsoho a hao ka mor'a ho ama liphoofolo kapa molapo oa tsona.

english_text: Wash your hands after handling raw meat or poultry.
sesotho_text: Hlatsoa matsoho a hao ka mor'a ho sebetsa le nama e hloekileng kapa manong.

english_text: Use an alcohol-based hand sanitiser when soap is not available.
sesotho_text: Sebelisa sanitiser ea matsoho e thehiloeng ho joala ha sesepa se sa fumanehe.

english_text: Cover your mouth and nose when you cough or sneeze.
sesotho_text: Koahela molomo le nko ha o kohoa kapa o thiimela.

english_text: Use a tissue when you cough or sneeze and dispose of it immediately.
sesotho_text: Sebelisa tissue ha o kohoa kapa o thiimela mme o e lahle hang hang.

english_text: Avoid touching your face with unwashed hands.
sesotho_text: Hana ho ama sefahleho sa hao ka matsoho a sa hlatsoang.

english_text: Avoid sharing personal items such as towels and toothbrushes.
sesotho_text: Hana ho arolelana lintho tsa botho joalo ka lithaole le likolobetso tsa meno.

english_text: Keep your home clean and well ventilated.
sesotho_text: Boloka ntlo ea hao e hloekileng le e nang le moea o lekaneng.

english_text: Open windows to allow fresh air into your home.
sesotho_text: Bula lifensetere ho lumella moea o mocha ho kena ntlong ea hao.

english_text: Clean and disinfect frequently touched surfaces regularly.
sesotho_text: Hlotsa le disinfect meaho e amoang hangata ka mehla.

english_text: Wash your clothes and bedding regularly.
sesotho_text: Hlatsoa liaparo tsa hao le liaparo tsa bolao ka mehla.

english_text: Bathe or shower every day to maintain personal hygiene.
sesotho_text: Khapa kapa shower letsatsi le leng le le leng ho boloka bohloekileng ba botho.

english_text: Brush your teeth at least twice a day.
sesotho_text: Kolobetsa meno a hao bonyane habeli ka letsatsi.

english_text: Use clean and safe drinking water at all times.
sesotho_text: Sebelisa metsi a hloekileng a bolokehileng a ho noa nako tsohle.

english_text: Boil water if you are unsure whether it is safe to drink.
sesotho_text: Besa metsi haeba ha o tsebe haeba a bolokehile ho noa.

english_text: Store drinking water in a clean covered container.
sesotho_text: Boloka metsi a ho noa setsing se hloekileng se koahetseng.

english_text: Wash fruits and vegetables before eating them.
sesotho_text: Hlatsoa lienyane le merogo pele ho li ja.

english_text: Cook meat and poultry thoroughly before eating.
sesotho_text: Phehla nama le manong ka botlalo pele ho ja.

english_text: Avoid eating food that has been left out for more than two hours.
sesotho_text: Hana ho ja lijo tse siileng kantle ho fetang lihora tse peli.

english_text: Refrigerate leftovers promptly to prevent food poisoning.
sesotho_text: Kenya lijo tse setseng frijeng hang hang ho thibela ho hlohlona ha lijo.

english_text: Avoid sharing food or drinks with someone who is sick.
sesotho_text: Hana ho arolelana lijo kapa lino le motho ea kulang.

english_text: Stay at home when you are sick to prevent spreading illness.
sesotho_text: Lula lapeng ha o kula ho thibela ho atatela ha bolwetse.

english_text: Wear a mask if you have a respiratory illness.
sesotho_text: Apara mask haeba o na le bolwetse ba ho hema.

english_text: Dispose of waste properly to prevent the spread of disease.
sesotho_text: Lahla molapo ka nepo ho thibela ho atatela ha bolwetse.

english_text: Use a toilet or latrine and do not defecate in the open.
sesotho_text: Sebelisa ntlo ea thokomelo kapa latrine mme o se ke oa ithokomela kantle.

english_text: Wash your hands after using the toilet or latrine.
sesotho_text: Hlatsoa matsoho a hao ka mor'a ho sebelisa ntlo ea thokomelo kapa latrine.

english_text: Keep your toilet or latrine clean and covered.
sesotho_text: Boloka ntlo ea hao ea thokomelo kapa latrine e hloekileng le e koahetseng.

english_text: Use insect repellent to protect against mosquito bites.
sesotho_text: Sebelisa sesebelisoa sa ho lelekisa likhoasane ho sireletsa ho lomoa ke tsona.

english_text: Sleep under a mosquito net to prevent malaria.
sesotho_text: Robala tlasa nete ea likhoasane ho thibela malaria.

english_text: Wear long sleeves and trousers in areas with many mosquitoes.
sesotho_text: Apara mahalapa a matelele le sekhahla sebakeng se nang le likhoasane tse ngata.

english_text: Remove standing water around your home to prevent mosquito breeding.
sesotho_text: Ntša metsi a emiseng haufi le ntlo ea hao ho thibela ho hola ha likhoasane.

english_text: Wear shoes to protect your feet from soil-transmitted infections.
sesotho_text: Apara lieta ho sireletsa maoto a hao ho tšoaetso tse fetisanang ka mobu.

english_text: Avoid walking barefoot in areas with animal waste.
sesotho_text: Hana ho tsamaea o sa apere lieta sebakeng se nang le molapo oa liphoofolo.

english_text: Protect your skin from cuts and wounds to prevent infection.
sesotho_text: Sireletsa letlalo la hao ho likhato le maqeba ho thibela tšoaetso.

english_text: Clean and cover all wounds immediately to prevent infection.
sesotho_text: Hlotsa le koahela maqeba ohle hang hang ho thibela tšoaetso.

english_text: Seek medical attention for wounds that do not heal.
sesotho_text: Batla tlhokomelo ea bongaka bakeng sa maqeba a sa foleng.

english_text: Avoid contact with the blood or body fluids of other people.
sesotho_text: Hana ho ama mali kapa metsi a 'mele a batho ba bang.

english_text: Use gloves when handling blood or body fluids.
sesotho_text: Sebelisa likhohlo ha o sebetsa le mali kapa metsi a 'mele.

english_text: Dispose of sharp objects safely to prevent needle-stick injuries.
sesotho_text: Lahla lintho tse bohale ka polokeho ho thibela likotsi tsa ho hlabua ke linalete.

english_text: Do not reuse syringes or needles.
sesotho_text: O se ke oa sebelisa hape li-syringe kapa linalete.

english_text: Use condoms consistently to prevent sexually transmitted infections.
sesotho_text: Sebelisa li-condom kamehla ho thibela tšoaetso tse fetisanang ka thobalano.

english_text: Get tested for sexually transmitted infections regularly.
sesotho_text: Hlahlojoa bakeng sa tšoaetso tse fetisanang ka thobalano ka mehla.

english_text: Inform your sexual partner if you have a sexually transmitted infection.
sesotho_text: Tsebisa molekane oa hao oa thobalano haeba o na le tšoaetso e fetisanang ka thobalano.

english_text: Seek treatment for sexually transmitted infections immediately.
sesotho_text: Batla phekolo bakeng sa tšoaetso tse fetisanang ka thobalano hang hang.

english_text: Avoid sexual contact until your sexually transmitted infection is treated.
sesotho_text: Hana ho kopana ka thobalano ho fihlela tšoaetso ea hao e fetisanang ka thobalano e alafoa.

english_text: Reduce your number of sexual partners to lower your risk of infection.
sesotho_text: Fokotsa palo ea baratwi ba hao ba thobalano ho fokotsa kotsi ea tšoaetso.

english_text: Discuss your sexual health openly with your healthcare provider.
sesotho_text: Buisana ka bophelo ba hao ba thobalano ka bolokolohi le mofani oa hao oa tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle.

english_text: Do not stigmatise people living with infectious diseases.
sesotho_text: O se ke oa nyatsa batho ba phelang le mahlwetse a tšoaetsang.

english_text: Treat people with infectious diseases with dignity and respect.
sesotho_text: Phethela batho ba nang le mahlwetse a tšoaetsang ka tlotlo le hlompho.

english_text: Support family members and friends who are living with illness.
sesotho_text: Tshehetsa maloko a lelapa le metsoalle ba phelang le bolwetse.

english_text: Encourage people in your community to seek medical care early.
sesotho_text: Khothaletsa batho sechababeng sa hao ho batla tlhokomelo ea bongaka kapele.

english_text: Share health information with your family and community.
sesotho_text: Arolelana tlhahisoleseling ea bophelo bo botle le lelapa la hao le sechaba.

english_text: Attend community health education sessions at your local clinic.
sesotho_text: Tla li-session tsa thuto ea bophelo bo botle ea sechaba klinikeng ea hao ea haufi.

english_text: Ask your community health worker for health advice and support.
sesotho_text: Botsa mosebetsi oa bophelo ba sechaba oa hao keletso ea bophelo le tshehetso.

english_text: Report disease outbreaks in your community to the health authorities.
sesotho_text: Bua ka ho atatela ha mahlwetse sechababeng sa hao ho ba ba nang le matla a bophelo bo botle.

english_text: Follow public health guidelines during disease outbreaks.
sesotho_text: Latela litaelo tsa bophelo ba sechaba nakong ea ho atatela ha mahlwetse.

english_text: Cooperate with health workers during community health campaigns.
sesotho_text: Sebetsa hammoho le basebetsi ba bophelo bo botle nakong ea likhampheini tsa bophelo ba sechaba.

english_text: Eating a balanced diet is essential for good health.
sesotho_text: Ho ja phepo e lekaneng ho bohlokoa bakeng sa bophelo bo botle.

english_text: A balanced diet includes foods from all the major food groups.
sesotho_text: Phepo e lekaneng e kenyelletsa lijo ho tsoa lihlopheng tsohle tse kholo tsa lijo.

english_text: Eat plenty of fruits and vegetables every day.
sesotho_text: Ja lienyane le merogo e ngata letsatsi le leng le le leng.

english_text: Choose whole grains over refined grains for better nutrition.
sesotho_text: Khetha lijo tsa mabele a phethahetseng ho e-na le a hlophisitsoeng bakeng sa phepo e ntle.

english_text: Include protein-rich foods such as meat, fish, eggs, and legumes.
sesotho_text: Kenyelletsa lijo tse nang le protein e ngata joalo ka nama, tlhapi, mae, le linaoa.

english_text: Eat dairy products or calcium-rich foods for strong bones.
sesotho_text: Ja lihlahisoa tsa lebese kapa lijo tse nang le calcium e ngata bakeng sa marapo a matla.

english_text: Limit your intake of foods high in sugar and salt.
sesotho_text: Fokotsa ho nka lijo tse nang le tsoekere e ngata le letsoai.

english_text: Avoid processed and fast foods as much as possible.
sesotho_text: Hana lijo tse entsoeng ka mokhoa oa indasteri le lijo tsa potlako kamoo ho khonehang.

english_text: Cook with healthy oils such as olive oil or sunflower oil.
sesotho_text: Phehla ka oli e ntle joalo ka oli ea olive kapa ea sunflower.

english_text: Avoid frying food and choose grilling or steaming instead.
sesotho_text: Hana ho frae lijo mme u khethe ho grilla kapa ho phehla ka moea.

english_text: Eat smaller portions more frequently throughout the day.
sesotho_text: Ja likarolo tse nyenyane hangata letsatsing la hao.

english_text: Do not skip meals especially breakfast.
sesotho_text: O se ke oa tlohela lijo haholo-holo sarapotso.

english_text: Drink at least eight glasses of water every day.
sesotho_text: Noa bonyane ligilase tse robeli tsa metsi letsatsi le leng le le leng.

english_text: Avoid sugary drinks such as cool drinks and fruit juices.
sesotho_text: Hana lino tse nang le tsoekere joalo ka li-cool drink le lijuisi tsa lienyane.

english_text: Limit your intake of caffeinated drinks such as tea and coffee.
sesotho_text: Fokotsa ho nka lino tse nang le caffeine joalo ka tee le kofi.

english_text: Avoid alcohol or drink only in moderation.
sesotho_text: Hana joala kapa noa feela ka tekanyo.

english_text: Read food labels to understand what you are eating.
sesotho_text: Bala lilebele tsa lijo ho utloisisa se o se jang.

english_text: Choose foods that are low in saturated fat and cholesterol.
sesotho_text: Khetha lijo tse tlase ho mafura a saturated le cholesterol.

english_text: Increase your fibre intake by eating more vegetables and whole grains.
sesotho_text: Eketsa ho nka fibre ka ho ja merogo e mengata le mabele a phethahetseng.

english_text: Fibre helps prevent constipation and reduces the risk of bowel cancer.
sesotho_text: Fibre e thusa ho thibela ho tšoaroa le ho fokotsa kotsi ea kankere ea mala.

english_text: Iron-rich foods such as red meat and spinach prevent anaemia.
sesotho_text: Lijo tse nang le tšepe joalo ka nama e khubelu le spinach li thibela anaemia.

english_text: Vitamin C helps your body absorb iron from plant-based foods.
sesotho_text: Vitamin C e thusa 'mele oa hao ho nka tšepe ho tsoa lijong tse thehiloeng ho limela.

english_text: Folate-rich foods such as leafy greens are important during pregnancy.
sesotho_text: Lijo tse nang le folate joalo ka merogo e tala e bohlokoa nakong ea ho mitsa.

english_text: Vitamin D from sunlight and food is important for bone health.
sesotho_text: Vitamin D ho tsoa leseling la letsatsi le lijong e bohlokoa bakeng sa bophelo ba marapo.

english_text: Calcium-rich foods such as milk and cheese strengthen your bones.
sesotho_text: Lijo tse nang le calcium joalo ka lebese le chisi li matlafatsa marapo a hao.

english_text: Zinc-rich foods support your immune system and wound healing.
sesotho_text: Lijo tse nang le zinc li tshehetsa tšireletso ea 'mele oa hao le ho fola ha maqeba.

english_text: Omega-3 fatty acids from fish support heart and brain health.
sesotho_text: Li-omega-3 fatty acid ho tsoa tlhaping li tshehetsa bophelo ba pelo le boko.

english_text: Antioxidant-rich foods protect your body from cell damage.
sesotho_text: Lijo tse nang le li-antioxidant li sireletsa 'mele oa hao ho kotsi ea lisele.

english_text: A healthy diet supports your immune system and helps fight infection.
sesotho_text: Phepo e ntle e tshehetsa tšireletso ea 'mele oa hao le ho thusa ho loa le tšoaetso.

english_text: Good nutrition speeds up recovery from illness.
sesotho_text: Phepo e ntle e potlakisa ho fola ho tsoa bolwetseng.

english_text: Malnutrition weakens the immune system and increases the risk of infection.
sesotho_text: Ho hloka phepo ho fokotsa tšireletso ea 'mele le ho eketsa kotsi ea tšoaetso.

english_text: Obesity increases the risk of diabetes, heart disease, and cancer.
sesotho_text: Ho ba boima bo feteletseng ho eketsa kotsi ea tsoekere, bolwetse ba pelo, le kankere.

english_text: Physical activity combined with a healthy diet helps maintain a healthy weight.
sesotho_text: Mesebetsi ea 'mele hammoho le phepo e ntle e thusa ho boloka boima bo botle.

english_text: Avoid eating late at night to support healthy digestion.
sesotho_text: Hana ho ja bosiu bo le bebe ho tshehetsa ho phehla ha lijo hantle.

english_text: Chew your food slowly and thoroughly for better digestion.
sesotho_text: Hlafuna lijo tsa hao butle le ka botlalo bakeng sa ho phehla hantle.

english_text: Eat in a calm environment without distractions.
sesotho_text: Ja sebakeng se khutsolang ntle le ho tsieleha.

english_text: Plan your meals in advance to make healthier food choices.
sesotho_text: Rererela lijo tsa hao pele ho etsa likhetho tse ntle tsa lijo.

english_text: Prepare meals at home to control the ingredients and portions.
sesotho_text: Lokisa lijo lapeng ho laola lintho tse sebelisoang le likarolo.

english_text: Involve your family in preparing healthy meals.
sesotho_text: Kenyelletsa lelapa la hao ho lokisa lijo tse ntle.

english_text: Teach your children about healthy eating from an early age.
sesotho_text: Ruta bana ba hao ka ho ja hantle ho tloha bonyenyane.

english_text: Grow your own vegetables if possible to improve food security.
sesotho_text: Hola merogo ea hao haeba ho khonehile ho ntlafatsa ts'ireletso ea lijo.

english_text: Access community food programmes if you are struggling to afford food.
sesotho_text: Fihlela mananeo a lijo a sechaba haeba o na le bothata ba ho lefella lijo.

english_text: Ask the clinic dietitian for personalised nutrition advice.
sesotho_text: Botsa dietitian ea kliniki keletso ea phepo e hlokehalang bakeng sa hao.

english_text: Follow the nutrition plan given to you by your healthcare provider.
sesotho_text: Latela leano la phepo le fanoeng ho uena ke mofani oa hao oa tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle.

english_text: Inform your doctor if you are struggling to afford nutritious food.
sesotho_text: Tsebisa ngaka ea hao haeba o na le bothata ba ho lefella lijo tse nang le phepo.

english_text: Social grants and food assistance programmes are available to those in need.
sesotho_text: Liphallelo tsa sechaba le mananeo a thuso ea lijo li fumaneha ho ba ba hlokang.

english_text: Good nutrition is a right and not a privilege.
sesotho_text: Phepo e ntle ke tokelo e seng molemo o khethehileng.

english_text: A well-nourished body heals faster and fights disease better.
sesotho_text: Mele o nang le phepo e lekaneng o fola kapele mme o loa le bolwetse hantle.

english_text: Nutrition and medication work together to improve your health.
sesotho_text: Phepo le moriana li sebetsa hammoho ho ntlafatsa bophelo ba hao.

english_text: Do not take your medication on an empty stomach unless instructed.
sesotho_text: O se ke oa nka moriana oa hao maleng a se nang letho ntle le ho laeloa.

english_text: Some medications must be taken with food to reduce side effects.
sesotho_text: Meriana e meng e tlameha ho nkoa le lijo ho fokotsa litlamorao.

english_text: Some medications must be taken on an empty stomach to be absorbed properly.
sesotho_text: Meriana e meng e tlameha ho nkoa maleng a se nang letho ho nkoa hantle.

english_text: Ask your pharmacist about the best way to take your medication.
sesotho_text: Botsa pharmacist ea hao ka mokhoa o motle ka ho fetisisa oa ho nka moriana oa hao.

english_text: Certain foods can interact with your medication and reduce its effectiveness.
sesotho_text: Lijo tse ling li ka kopana le moriana oa hao mme li fokotse bokgoni ba ona.

english_text: Grapefruit can interact with some medications and should be avoided.
sesotho_text: Grapefruit e ka kopana le meriana e meng mme e lokela ho hanoa.

english_text: Dairy products can reduce the absorption of some antibiotics.
sesotho_text: Lihlahisoa tsa lebese li ka fokotsa ho nkoa ha li-antibiotic tse ling.

english_text: High-fat meals can affect how some medications are absorbed.
sesotho_text: Lijo tse nang le mafura a mangata li ka angoa ho nkoa ha meriana e meng.

english_text: Alcohol interacts with many medications and should be avoided.
sesotho_text: Joala le kopana le meriana e mengata mme le lokela ho hanoa.

english_text: Always inform your doctor about your diet when discussing your medication.
sesotho_text: Tsebisa ngaka ea hao kamehla ka phepo ea hao ha o buisana ka moriana oa hao.

english_text: A healthy diet is one of the most powerful tools for managing your health.
sesotho_text: Phepo e ntle ke e le ngoe ea lisebelisoa tse matla ka ho fetisisa tsa ho laola bophelo ba hao.

english_text: Regular physical activity improves your heart health.
sesotho_text: Mesebetsi ea 'mele ea kamehla e ntlafatsa bophelo ba pelo ea hao.

english_text: Exercise helps control blood sugar levels in people with diabetes.
sesotho_text: Ho itlama ho thusa ho laola maemo a tsoekere ea mali ho batho ba nang le tsoekere.

english_text: Physical activity helps lower high blood pressure.
sesotho_text: Mesebetsi ea 'mele e thusa ho fokotsa khatello e phahameng ea mali.

english_text: Exercise helps maintain a healthy weight.
sesotho_text: Ho itlama ho thusa ho boloka boima bo botle.

english_text: Regular physical activity improves your mental health and mood.
sesotho_text: Mesebetsi ea 'mele ea kamehla e ntlafatsa bophelo ba hao ba kelello le maikutlo.

english_text: Exercise reduces the risk of depression and anxiety.
sesotho_text: Ho itlama ho fokotsa kotsi ea khutsanyetso le ho tšoha.

english_text: Physical activity improves your sleep quality.
sesotho_text: Mesebetsi ea 'mele e ntlafatsa boleng ba boroko ba hao.

english_text: Exercise strengthens your muscles and bones.
sesotho_text: Ho itlama ho matlafatsa mochine le marapo a hao.

english_text: Regular physical activity reduces the risk of falls in older adults.
sesotho_text: Mesebetsi ea 'mele ea kamehla e fokotsa kotsi ea ho wa ho batho ba baholo.

english_text: Exercise improves your energy levels and reduces fatigue.
sesotho_text: Ho itlama ho ntlafatsa maemo a matla a hao le ho fokotsa ho lapala.

english_text: Physical activity boosts your immune system.
sesotho_text: Mesebetsi ea 'mele e matlafatsa tšireletso ea 'mele oa hao.

english_text: Exercise reduces the risk of heart disease and stroke.
sesotho_text: Ho itlama ho fokotsa kotsi ea bolwetse ba pelo le stroke.

english_text: Regular physical activity reduces the risk of certain cancers.
sesotho_text: Mesebetsi ea 'mele ea kamehla e fokotsa kotsi ea kankere tse ling.

english_text: Exercise improves your flexibility and balance.
sesotho_text: Ho itlama ho ntlafatsa ho otlolla le tekanyo ea hao.

english_text: Physical activity helps manage chronic pain.
sesotho_text: Mesebetsi ea 'mele e thusa ho laola mahloko a tsoelang pele.

english_text: Aim for at least thirty minutes of moderate exercise most days.
sesotho_text: Leka bonyane metsotso e mashome a mararo ea ho itlama ka tekanyo matsatsi a mangata.

english_text: Walking is a simple and effective form of physical activity.
sesotho_text: Ho tsamaea ke mokhoa o bonolo le o sebetsang oa mesebetsi ea 'mele.

english_text: Cycling, swimming, and dancing are all good forms of exercise.
sesotho_text: Ho palama baesekele, ho nea le ho bina ke mekhoa e ntle ea ho itlama.

english_text: Household chores and gardening also count as physical activity.
sesotho_text: Mesebetsi ea lapeng le ho lema le yona e bala joalo ka mesebetsi ea 'mele.

english_text: Start slowly and gradually increase the intensity of your exercise.
sesotho_text: Qala butle mme o eketse bohale ba ho itlama ha hao butle butle.
